{'index': 0, 'text': "The new Apple TV 4K is long overdue, originally expected to launch last autumn. But with Siri AI finally ready, all signs point to the new Apple TV 4K making its debut, possibly at the September 9 event. Here's what the rumours say so far."}

{'index': 1, 'text': '#1: Siri Remote Update'}

{'index': 2, 'text': "While details haven't been made public, reports suggest Apple will launch an updated Siri Remote for the new Apple TV 4K."}

{'index': 3, 'text': 'Code leaked in a version of macOS 26.7 appears to confirm the existence of a new Siri Remote. And before that leak, Mark Gurman had reported that the new hardware could come with a "revised Apple TV remote".'}

{'index': 4, 'text': "It doesn't sound like there will be major changes, but hopefully it will at least get a second-generation ultra-wideband chip to support Precision Finding."}

{'index': 5, 'text': '#2: Siri AI and More Apple Intelligence Features'}

{'index': 6, 'text': 'Siri AI is expected to be one of the key marketing focuses for the new Apple TV and other new home products.'}

{'index': 7, 'text': "Apple has yet to announce whether this new assistant will land on the Apple TV 4K or HomePod. But there's growing evidence that tvOS 27 will add Siri AI, and it's likely to only be available on the new hardware."}

{'index': 8, 'text': 'There will also likely be other Apple Intelligence features added at that time, such as an improved search experience.'}

{'index': 9, 'text': '#3: Brand New A-Series Chip'}

{'index': 10, 'text': 'The current Apple TV uses the A15 Bionic chip that first debuted in 2021. The good news is that the new version should see a significant performance boost.'}

{'index': 11, 'text': 'The new A-series chip will be more powerful and support various AI features.'}

{'index': 12, 'text': "There are rumours it could use the A17 Pro or A18 chip. However, most of those reports came out before Siri AI was unveiled. It wouldn't be surprising for Apple to pair the new hardware with a more powerful A19 or A20 chip."}

{'index': 13, 'text': '#4: N1 Wireless Chip'}

{'index': 14, 'text': 'The N1 wireless chip, first used in the iPhone 17, is also reportedly being adopted for the new Apple TV 4K.'}

{'index': 15, 'text': 'With the N1 chip added, the Apple TV will support Wi-Fi 7 and Bluetooth 6, as well as Thread networking technology.'}

{'index': 16, 'text': 'By comparison, the current four-year-old Apple TV hardware only offers Wi-Fi 6 and Bluetooth 5.'}

{'index': 17, 'text': 'What features do you hope the new Apple TV 4K will add? Let us know in the comments.'}
